name: Card Sharp (Cartomancer Games)
body:
Not only are your cards magical implements, but they are also potent weapons.

Card Toss (Su)

At 1st level, you use cards in your hand as weapons. When you discard a card as a standard action, you can make a ranged touch attack with a 20-foot range that deals 1d4 plus your Charisma modifier slashing damage. These attacks count as magical for damage reduction purposes. Cards are destroyed after they are thrown.

Energetic Card (Su)

At 6th level, when you attack with a card that has the acid, cold, electricity fire, force, negative energy, positive energy, or sonic trait, you can change the attack’s damage type to one matching the card’s traits. If the card has more than one valid trait, choose one. Additionally, attacks you make with cards deal an additional 1d6 damage of the same type as the car’s damage, increasing to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 18th level.

Across the Table (Su)

At 11th level, your range with card attacks increases to 40 feet. Additionally, you may discard two cards to make two attacks instead of one.

Both attacks are made at your highest base attack bonus by both take a -2 penalty on the attack. In all other respects this acts as card toss.

Stack them Up (Su)

At 18th level, you gain a third attack with your card toss ability if you so choose, the penalty remains -2. Additionally, when you hit a creature with at least two attacks made with cards of the same suit in one turn, you can apply an additional effect based on the suit of the cards used.

Hearts: The creature must succeed on a Will save or be frightened for 1d6 rounds per card hit of the same suit. That creature can make a new save to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.
Diamonds: The creature’s pain and suffering linger. The Target is sickened for 1 round per card hit of the same suit, and at the beginning of your next turn the creature takes 1d4 bleed damage per card hit of the same suit..
Clubs: The creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be pushed back up to 5 feet per card hit of the same suit. This is forced movement that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Spades: The creature must succeed on a Reflex save or fall prone.
